# Phase 1A Dependency Map

**Status:** Generated by reading each workspace package's actual `package.json` (not hand-maintained prose that can drift). Re-run the command in "How this was generated" below to refresh.

## Internal (`@webdesk/*`) dependency graph

```
@webdesk/dashboard-api    -> @webdesk/configuration, @webdesk/shared-types, @webdesk/validation
@webdesk/dashboard-web    -> @webdesk/configuration, @webdesk/shared-types, @webdesk/ui
@webdesk/dashboard-worker -> @webdesk/configuration, @webdesk/shared-types
@webdesk/database         -> @webdesk/shared-types
@webdesk/integrations     -> @webdesk/configuration
@webdesk/configuration    -> (none)
@webdesk/shared-types     -> (none)
@webdesk/ui               -> (none)
@webdesk/validation       -> (none)
```

Notably **not present** (by design, per `README.md`'s dependency rules, mechanically enforced by `pnpm boundaries:check` — see `dependency-cruiser.config.cjs`):

- `dashboard-web -> database` — dashboard-web never accesses the database (ADR-0002)
- `dashboard-web -> integrations` — dashboard-web never calls integration adapters directly
- Any `packages/* -> apps/*` edge — dependency flow is one-directional
- `dashboard-api -> database` and `dashboard-worker -> database`/`integrations` are also currently absent — Phase 1A's `packages/database` and `packages/integrations` are interface-only placeholders (see `docs/implementation/phase-1a-file-inventory.md`) not yet wired into the apps that will eventually consume them (Phase 1B+)

## Key external dependencies by app/package

| App/Package              | Notable external dependencies                                                                              | Why                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `dashboard-api`          | `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,swagger}`, `nestjs-pino`, `reflect-metadata`, `rxjs`, `uuid`, `zod` | NestJS foundation (ADR-0003), Pino-compatible structured logging, Zod validation (never class-validator, per profile `knowledge/03-nestjs-on-vercel.md`) |
| `dashboard-web`          | `next`, `react`, `react-dom`, `zod`                                                                        | Next.js App Router (ADR-0002)                                                                                                                            |
| `dashboard-worker`       | `zod` only                                                                                                 | Deliberately minimal — no framework, matches ADR-0004's stateless-handler design                                                                         |
| `packages/configuration` | `zod`                                                                                                      | Environment-schema validation                                                                                                                            |
| `packages/validation`    | `zod`                                                                                                      | Shared schemas                                                                                                                                           |
| `packages/database`      | none yet                                                                                                   | Interface-only at Phase 1A; Sequelize is added in Phase 1B, not before                                                                                   |
| `packages/integrations`  | none yet                                                                                                   | Interface-only at Phase 1A                                                                                                                               |

## Dev/test tooling

`turbo`, `typescript`, `eslint` + `typescript-eslint` (flat config, root-level), `prettier`, `dependency-cruiser`, `vitest` (+ `unplugin-swc`/`@swc/core` for `dashboard-api`'s NestJS decorator metadata), `@playwright/test` (`dashboard-web` only), `@testing-library/react` (`dashboard-web` only), `supertest` (`dashboard-api` integration tests).

## Enforcement mechanism

`pnpm boundaries:check` runs `dependency-cruiser.config.cjs` against `apps/` and `packages/`, failing the check (`error` severity, non-zero exit) on any of: `dashboard-web -> database`, `dashboard-web -> integrations`, any `packages/* -> apps/*` edge, any circular package dependency, or any `sequelize` import outside `packages/database`. Wired into CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `boundaries` job).

## How this was generated

```bash
for f in apps/*/package.json packages/*/package.json; do
  pkg=$(node -pe "require('./$f').name")
  deps=$(node -pe "Object.keys({...require('./$f').dependencies}).filter(d=>d.startsWith('@webdesk/')).join(', ') || '(none)'")
  echo "$pkg -> $deps"
done
```
